content.text:
I've reviewed every responsive location. Here is my assessment before submitting:

- **p0078 (§13 Term of Agreement)** — the only renewal mechanic: initial 1-year term, then "renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods", with either party able to give "written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year."
- **p0047 (§6)** — hosting costs frozen for one year plus an MFN on rates; **p0045** — fees fixed by Exhibits "A"/"B"; **p0081** — any amendment must be signed by the party to be charged, so there is no unilateral renewal uplift right.
- No other renewal, extension, or escalation language exists (§2 licence term simply runs until termination).

Renewal term is 12 months (not multi-year) and the non-renewal window is 30 days (well inside both the ≤60-day fallback and the ≤30-day preferred opt-out), so this clears fallback and most of preferred. The only gaps — no 60-day vendor reminder and no express CPI/3% uplift cap — are the minor sub-elements the playbook says to note rather than redline, particularly as no price-increase mechanic exists to cap.

input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
input.rationale: Section 13 (p0078) is the only renewal mechanic: after a 1-year initial term the Agreement renews automatically for "successive one year periods" (12-month renewals, not multi-year), and either party — including us as Client — may prevent renewal by written notice given "no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year". The 30-day window sits inside the ≤60-day fallback and in fact matches the preferred ≤30-day opt-out, and the 12-month renewal length matches the preferred term cap, so the clause clears fallback comfortably and is well outside walk-away territory (no window over 90 days, no automatic multi-year renewal). On pricing, no renewal uplift right exists to cap: fees are fixed by the Exhibit "A"/"B" schedules (p0045), hosting costs are frozen for the first year with an MFN on rates (p0047), and any change requires an amendment "in writing and signed by the party to be charged" (p0081), so TrueLink cannot raise renewal pricing unilaterally. Two preferred-only sub-elements are absent and are noted rather than redlined per the playbook: there is no vendor reminder 60 days before renewal, and no express lesser-of-CPI-and-3% uplift cap. On these material terms the bargain is acceptable, so we are not redlining it.
